newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land vehicle sets Euro-Asian MBS.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land vehicle sets Euro-Asian MBS.

text.p: Sino Commercial Properties Funding, an offshore special purpose vehicle of Hong Kong's Sino Land, has launched the first Euro-Asian mortgage-backed security issue, lead manager Morgan Stanley International said Monday.
The US$300 million floating rate note issue is secured by two mortgage loans on Sino Land commercial properties in Hong Kong.
The issue has a legal final of March 2003 and an expected final of March 2002.
It will be priced on Tuesday during London hours at 90-95 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
The issue is rated Single-A by both Standard and Poor's Corp and Fitch.
The issue will be marketed in the U.S., Europe and Asia, a syndicate manager at Morgan Stanley said. The issue already has been oversubscribed, he said.
